tools.name: grep_scripts
tools.description: Ripgrep-inspired search across all script sources. Supports literal and Lua pattern matching, context lines, early termination, and results grouped by script with line/column numbers.

pattern.description: Search pattern (literal string or Lua pattern)

usePattern.description: Use Lua pattern matching instead of literal (default: false)

contextLines.description: Number of context lines before/after each match (default: 0)

filesOnly.description: Only return matching script paths, not line details (default: false)

classFilter.description: Only search scripts of this class type

tools.name: start_playtest
tools.description: Start playtest. Captures print/warn/error via LogService. Poll with get_playtest_output, end with stop_playtest. Use numPlayers for multi-client testing (server + N clients).

numPlayers.description: Number of client players (1-8). Triggers server + clients mode via TestService.

tools.name: stop_playtest
tools.description: Stop playtest and return all captured output.

tools.name: get_playtest_output
tools.description: Poll output buffer without stopping. Returns isRunning and captured messages.

tools.name: get_connected_instances
tools.description: List all connected plugin instances with their roles. Use during multi-client playtest to discover server and client instances for targeted commands.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change in Roblox Studio. Uses ChangeHistoryService to reverse the most recent operation.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change in Roblox Studio. Uses ChangeHistoryService to reapply the most recently undone operation.

tools.name: export_build
tools.description: Export a Model/Folder into a compact, token-efficient build JSON format and auto-save it to the local build library. The output contains a palette (unique BrickColor+Material combos mapped to short keys) and compact part arrays with positions normalized relative to the bounding box center. The file is saved to build-library/{style}/{id}.json automatically.

instancePath.description: Path to the Model or Folder to export (dot notation)

outputId.description: Build ID for the output (e.g. "medieval/cottage_01"). Defaults to style/instance_name.

style.description: Style category for the build (default: misc)

tools.name: create_build
tools.description: Create a new build model from scratch and save it to the library. Define parts using compact arrays [posX, posY, posZ, sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ, paletteKey, shape?, transparency?]. Palette maps short keys to [BrickColor, Material] pairs. The build is saved and can be referenced by import_build or import_scene.

palette.description: Map of short keys to [BrickColor, Material] or [BrickColor, Material, MaterialVariant] tuples. E.g. {"a": ["Dark stone grey", "Concrete"], "b": ["Brown", "Wood", "MyCustomWood"]}

parts.description: Array of parts. Object format: {position:[x,y,z], size:[x,y,z], rotation:[x,y,z], paletteKey, shape?, transparency?}. Tuple format [posX,posY,posZ,sizeX,sizeY,sizeZ,rotX,rotY,rotZ,paletteKey,shape?,transparency?] also accepted.

bounds.description: Optional bounding box [X, Y, Z]. Auto-computed if omitted.

tools.name: generate_build
tools.description:
Procedurally generate a build via JS code. ALWAYS generate the entire scene in ONE call — never split into multiple small builds. PREFER high-level primitives over manual loops. No comments. No unnecessary variables. Maximize build detail per line.

EDITING: When modifying an existing build, call get_build first to retrieve the original code. Then make ONLY the targeted changes the user requested — do not rewrite unchanged code. Pass the modified code to generate_build.

HIGH-LEVEL (use these first — each replaces 5-20 lines):
  room(x,y,z, w,h,d, wallKey, floorKey?, ceilKey?, wallThickness?) - Complete enclosed room (floor+ceiling+4 walls)
  roof(x,y,z, w,d, style, key, overhang?) - style: "flat"|"gable"|"hip"
  stairs(x1,y1,z1, x2,y2,z2, width, key) - Auto-generates steps between two points
  column(x,y,z, height, radius, key, capKey?) - Cylinder with base+capital
  pew(x,y,z, w,d, seatKey, legKey?) - Bench with seat+backrest+legs
  arch(x,y,z, w,h, thickness, key, segments?) - Curved archway
  fence(x1,z1, x2,z2, y, key, postSpacing?) - Fence with posts+rails

BASIC:
  part(x,y,z, sx,sy,sz, key, shape?, transparency?)
  rpart(x,y,z, sx,sy,sz, rx,ry,rz, key, shape?, transparency?)
  wall(x1,z1, x2,z2, height, thickness, key) — vertical plane from (x1,z1) to (x2,z2)
  floor(x1,z1, x2,z2, y, thickness, key) — horizontal plane at height y, corners (x1,z1)-(x2,z2). NOT fill — only takes 2D corners+y, not 3D points
  fill(x1,y1,z1, x2,y2,z2, key, [ux,uy,uz]?) — 3D volume between two 3D points
  beam(x1,y1,z1, x2,y2,z2, thickness, key)

IMPORTANT: Palette keys must match exactly. Use only keys defined in your palette object, not color names.
CUSTOM MATERIALS: Use search_materials to find MaterialVariant names, then reference them as the 3rd palette element: {"a": ["Color", "BaseMaterial", "VariantName"]}.

REPETITION:
  row(x,y,z, count, spacingX, spacingZ, fn(i,cx,cy,cz))
  grid(x,y,z, countX, countZ, spacingX, spacingZ, fn(ix,iz,cx,cy,cz))

Shapes: Block(default), Wedge, Cylinder, Ball, CornerWedge. Max 10000 parts. Math and rng() available.
CYLINDER AXIS: Roblox cylinders extend along the X axis. For upright cylinders, use size (height, diameter, diameter) with rz=90. The column() primitive handles this automatically.

EXAMPLE — compact cabin (17 lines):
room(0,0,0,8,4,6,"a","b","a")
roof(0,4,0,8,6,"gable","c")
wall(-4,0,-2,4,0,-2,4,1,"a")
part(0,2,3,3,3,0.3,"a","Block",0.4)
row(-2,0,-1,3,0,2,(i,cx,cy,cz)=>{pew(cx,0,cz,3,2,"d")})
column(-3,0,-2,4,0.5,"a","b")
column(3,0,-2,4,0.5,"a","b")
part(0,2,0,2,1,1,"b")

palette.description: Map of short keys to [BrickColor, Material] or [BrickColor, Material, MaterialVariant] tuples. E.g. {"a": ["Dark stone grey", "Cobblestone"], "b": ["Brown", "WoodPlanks", "MyCustomWood"]}. MaterialVariant is optional — use it to reference custom materials from MaterialService.

code.description: JavaScript code using the primitives above to generate parts procedurally

seed.description: Optional seed for deterministic rng() output (default: 42)

tools.name: import_build
tools.description: Import a build into Roblox Studio. Accepts either a full build data object OR a library ID string (e.g. "medieval/church_01") to load from the build library. When using generate_build or create_build, pass the build ID string instead of the full data.

buildData.description: Either a build data object (with palette, parts, etc.) OR a library ID string (e.g. "medieval/church_01") to load from the build library

targetPath.description: Parent instance path where the model will be created

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: List available builds in the local build library. Returns build IDs, styles, bounds, and part counts. Optionally filter by style.

tools.name: search_materials
tools.description: Search for MaterialVariant instances in MaterialService by name. Use this to find custom materials before using them in generate_build or create_build palettes. Returns material names and their base material types.

query.description: Search query to match against material names (case-insensitive). Leave empty to list all.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get a build from the library by ID. Returns metadata, palette, and generator code (if the build was created with generate_build). IMPORTANT: When the user asks to modify an existing build, ALWAYS call get_build first to retrieve the original code, then make targeted edits to only the relevant lines, and call generate_build with the modified code. Never rewrite the entire code from scratch — only change what the user asked to change.

tools.name: import_scene
tools.description: Import a full scene layout. Provide a scene with model references (resolved from library) and placement data. Each model is placed at the specified position/rotation. Can also include inline custom builds.

sceneData.description: Scene layout object with: models (map of key to library build ID), place (array of [key, position, rotation?]), and optional custom (array of inline build objects with name, position, palette, parts)

models.description: Map of short keys to library build IDs (e.g. {"A": "medieval/cottage_01"})

place.description: Array of placements. Preferred format: {modelKey, position:[x,y,z], rotation?:[x,y,z]}. Legacy tuple format [modelKey, [x,y,z], [rotX?,rotY?,rotZ?]] is also accepted.

custom.description: Array of inline custom builds with {n: name, o: [x,y,z], palette: {...}, parts: [...]}

targetPath.description: Parent instance path for the scene (default: game.Workspace)

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search the Creator Store (Roblox marketplace) for assets by type and keywords. Requires ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY env var (no cookie auth for this endpoint).

assetType.description: Type of asset to search for

verifiedCreatorsOnly.description: Only show assets from verified creators (default: false)

tools.name: get_asset_details
tools.description: Get detailed marketplace metadata for a specific asset. Uses ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY or falls back to ROBLOSECURITY cookie (own assets only).

tools.name: get_asset_thumbnail
tools.description: Get the thumbnail image for an asset as base64 PNG, suitable for vision LLMs. Thumbnails API is public but asset validation uses ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY.

tools.name: insert_asset
tools.description: Insert a Roblox asset into Studio by loading it via AssetService and parenting it to a target location. Optionally set position.

assetId.description: The Roblox asset ID to insert

position.description: Optional world position to place the asset

tools.name: preview_asset
tools.description: Preview a Roblox asset without permanently inserting it. Loads the asset, builds a hierarchy tree with properties and summary stats, then destroys it. Useful for inspecting asset contents before insertion.

assetId.description: The Roblox asset ID to preview

includeProperties.description: Include detailed properties for each instance (default: true)

tools.name: upload_decal
tools.description: Upload an image file as a Decal asset to Roblox. Supports ROBLOSECURITY cookie auth (recommended, simpler) or ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY (needs asset:write scope + creator ID). Cookie auth is used automatically when ROBLOSECURITY is set.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file on disk (PNG, JPG, BMP, or TGA)

displayName.description: Display name for the decal asset (max 50 characters)

description.description: Description for the decal asset (default: empty string)

userId.description: Roblox user ID for the asset creator. Overrides ROBLOX_CREATOR_USER_ID env var.

groupId.description: Roblox group ID for the asset creator. Overrides ROBLOX_CREATOR_GROUP_ID env var. Takes precedence over userId if both provided.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the Roblox Studio viewport and return it as a PNG image. Requires EditableImage API to be enabled: Game Settings > Security > "Allow Mesh / Image APIs". Only works in Edit mode with the viewport visible.

tools.name: simulate_mouse_input
tools.description: Simulate mouse input in the Roblox Studio viewport via VirtualInputManager. Use during playtest to click UI buttons, interact with objects, or navigate menus. Coordinates are viewport pixels (top-left is 0,0). Use capture_screenshot to identify UI element positions before clicking.

action.description: Mouse action to perform. "click" does mouseDown + short delay + mouseUp.

tools.name: simulate_keyboard_input
tools.description: Simulate keyboard input via VirtualInputManager. Use during playtest for character movement (W/A/S/D), jumping (Space), interactions (E), or any key-driven action. For sustained movement, use "press" to hold and "release" to let go.

action.description: "tap" (default) = press + wait + release. "press" = key down only. "release" = key up only.

duration.description: Hold duration in seconds for "tap" action (default: 0.1). Use longer values for sustained input like walking.

tools.name: character_navigation
tools.description: Move the player character to a target position or instance during playtest. Uses PathfindingService for automatic navigation around obstacles, falling back to direct movement. Requires an active playtest in "play" mode. Does NOT simulate player input — moves the character directly.

position.description: Target world position [x, y, z]. Either this or instancePath is required.

instancePath.description: Instance to navigate to (dot notation). The character walks to its Position. Either this or position is required.

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the character to arrive before returning (default: true)

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for navigation to complete (default: 25)

tools.name: clone_object
tools.description: Clone an instance to a new parent location. Creates a deep copy of the instance and all its descendants.

instancePath.description: Path of the instance to clone

targetParentPath.description: Path of the parent to place the clone under

tools.name: move_object
tools.description: Move (reparent) an instance to a new parent location. Preserves all children and properties.

instancePath.description: Path of the instance to move

tools.name: rename_object
tools.description: Rename an instance.

instancePath.description: Path of the instance to rename

tools.name: get_descendants
tools.description: Get all descendants of an instance recursively with depth info. More efficient than repeated get_instance_children calls.

classFilter.description: Only include instances of this class (uses IsA, so "BasePart" matches Part, MeshPart, etc.)

tools.name: compare_instances
tools.description: Diff two instances by comparing their properties. Useful for debugging why a duplicate behaves differently.

tools.name: get_output_log
tools.description: Get the Studio output log history. Works in both edit and play mode.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 100)

tools.name: get_script_analysis
tools.description: Run syntax analysis on Luau scripts using loadstring. Detects compile errors with line numbers. Pass a script path to analyze one script, or a container path to analyze all scripts under it.

instancePath.description: Instance path - either a script or a container whose descendant scripts will be analyzed

tools.name: bulk_set_attributes
tools.description: Set multiple attributes on an instance in a single call. More efficient than repeated set_attribute calls.

attributes.description: Map of attribute names to values. Supports Vector3, Color3, UDim2 via _type convention.

tools.name: find_and_replace_in_scripts
tools.description: Find and replace text across all scripts in the game. Supports literal and Lua pattern matching. Use dryRun to preview changes before applying. Pairs with grep_scripts for search-only operations.

pattern.description: Text or Lua pattern to find

replacement.description: Replacement text. When usePattern is true, supports Lua captures (%1, %2, etc.).

caseSensitive.description: Case-sensitive matching (default: false). Must be true when usePattern is true.

usePattern.description: Use Lua pattern matching instead of literal (default: false). Requires caseSensitive: true.

classFilter.description: Only search scripts of this class type

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying them (default: false)
